name: DiscordDeck
author: Lexodeus

publish.description: Adds Discord to the Steam menu. Opens Discord or Vesktop (Vencord) installed from Discover without adding it as a non-Steam game.

Changelog:
## 0.1.3 (2026-10-17)

- The Quick Access menu now mentions under the Close button that you can also close Discord by highlighting it in the Steam menu and pressing X.
